title: Public Enemy: Revolution Simulator
description:
CHECK OUT OUR NEW GAME!

Об игреFight for freedom of people in this dictature simulation!

Use different skills to make the revolt gauge grow!

Don't get caught by submitting yourself to guards' abuse of authority!

Paint graffitisImages are the best propaganda. Paint graffitis on walls, make them bigger to gain more revolt points.

Destroy power figures The icons of the dictature keeps it in position of power. Use a hammer to break them and help people rise.

Stick April Fool on the back of state guardsHumour is devastating against oppression. Stick April fool on the back of the guards to make them look ridiculous.

Without being caught and sent to jail!Abuse of authority, stupid orders, surveillance, are all dictature weapons to submit people. Be careful to stay discreet in order to prevent you from jail.

Warning: all sounds in this game are buccal.
